sys_script_include.description: Non-destructive What-If simulation engine for production scheduling. Supports 5 scenario types: resource_down, capacity_reduction, quantity_change, material_shortage, schedule_shift. READ-ONLY against production data. Records simulation results to sim_scenario and sim_schedule_run tables. Does NOT modify production_order, prod_sched, prod_res, inv_stock, inv_txn, or inv_req.
sys_script_include.name: WhatIfSimulationEngine
